target: NVIDIA Shield TV / darcy / original Tegra210 (A08 evaluation DT; physical board SKU unconfirmed)
scope: Full hardware support is the acceptance goal; none is yet physically qualified.

subsystems.name: CPU, RAM, compressed swap and CPU frequency scaling
subsystems.acceptance: Compare stock CPU topology, RAM, OPPs and sustained frequency at monitored temperatures. Verify the configured zstd zram swap device and pressure recovery.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Internal eMMC and partition identity
subsystems.acceptance: Read identity/partitions first; qualify reads and separately authorized writes without overwriting NVIDIA firmware.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Both USB host ports and USB SSD
subsystems.acceptance: Test each port at USB 2/3 speed with keyboard, SSD, hub, hotplug and sustained verified I/O.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Convertible USB device/debug port
subsystems.acceptance: Test host/device role switching and USB gadget enumeration on the PC.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Gigabit Ethernet
subsystems.acceptance: Match the actual PCIe adapter/driver to stock, negotiate link, test DHCP and sustained LAN traffic.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Wi-Fi, both bands and reconnect
subsystems.acceptance: Confirm actual SDIO chip/revision, correct Darcy calibration and unique platform MAC; test both bands, regulatory behavior, traffic and reconnect.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Bluetooth radio and peripherals
subsystems.acceptance: Identify the combo chip and exact firmware; test pairing, input and reconnect.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Shield remote/controller and microphone
subsystems.acceptance: Identify each actual accessory. Test Thunderstrike USB/Bluetooth buttons/axes, battery, LEDs and rumble, then each remote button, voice/microphone transport, pairing, IR and wake separately.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: HDMI display, EDID and hotplug
subsystems.acceptance: Test actual display modes, 1080p/4K and refresh rates, hotplug, reconnect, cursor and VT switching.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: HDMI audio and USB/Bluetooth audio
subsystems.acceptance: Test HDMI PCM at supported rates/channels, routing, USB/Bluetooth audio and codec passthrough separately.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: HDMI CEC control and wake
subsystems.acceptance: Confirm effective DT enablement, CEC adapter, key events, display control and wake behavior.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: GM20B GPU, OpenGL/EGL and Hyprland
subsystems.acceptance: Require a physical Nouveau renderer, EGL/OpenGL rendering, DMA-BUF sharing, Hyprland/Quickshell and monitored clock scaling; llvmpipe is not a pass.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: NVK Vulkan on GM20B
subsystems.acceptance: Qualify actual device enumeration, rendering and synchronization; no assumptions from generic Maxwell support.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Hardware video decode, encode and VIC
subsystems.acceptance: Validate the actual host1x/userspace API, firmware and codec/sample matrix with verified hardware execution and output, including advertised bit depths/resolutions.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Fan, sensors and thermal throttling
subsystems.acceptance: Verify idle fan/sensors and cooling-state transitions before progressively monitored load; compare trip points to stock.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Regulators, GPU/EMC clocks and idle power
subsystems.acceptance: Match rails/OPPs to the actual board; qualify CPU/GPU/EMC scaling and idle behavior without guessed voltage tables.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Suspend, resume and wake sources
subsystems.acceptance: Test repeated resume, remote/network/USB wake where supported, and peripheral/display recovery.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: Cold boot, reboot and stock recovery
subsystems.acceptance: Qualify the matched Android boot image, SSD root UUID, repeated standalone power cycles and an actual stock restoration route.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap

subsystems.name: HDR, Dolby and protected playback; generation-specific NVIDIA features
subsystems.acceptance: Qualify only capabilities present on the actual Darcy hardware; 2019-only AI upscaling is not a capability of this original Tegra210 target. Vendor userspace, licensing and DRM remain separate feasibility gaps.
subsystems.required_status: hardware-validated or an explicit unresolved capability gap
